verbatim_quote.original: Production path must stay throw-FetchError-based; never return error strings as successes. Every new direct HTTP path must pass assertSafeUrl.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Production path must stay throw-FetchError-based; never return error strings as successes. Every new direct HTTP path must pass assertSafeUrl.

extracted_decision.summary: Errors throw FetchError (isError:true); every new HTTP path passes the SSRF guard.
extracted_decision.rationale: Silent success strings hide failures from agents; unguarded URLs enable SSRF.
alternatives: Return error strings as normal results
Skip the guard for internal URLs
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Strict error handling may surface more failures, but never falsely succeeds.
